definition: A standard and friendly greeting used to address a group of people, an audience, or an entire community.
composition_note: 大家 (dàjiā, 'big family' = everybody / all) + 好 (hǎo, 'good' = hello / wishing well).
es: Hola a todos / Buenos días a todos
fr: Bonjour à tous / Bonjour tout le monde

example.zh: 大家早上好，我们开始上课吧！
example.pinyin: Dàjiā zǎoshang hǎo, wǒmen kāishǐ shàngkè ba!
example.en: Good morning everyone, let's start our class!
example.es: ¡Buenos días a todos, empecemos la clase!
example.fr: Bonjour à tous, commençons le cours !

note: Suitable for public speaking, classroom greetings, presentations, or entering a room.

definition: Respectful greeting addressed directly to a teacher, educator, or professor.
composition_note: 老师 (lǎoshī, title: teacher/master) + 好 (hǎo, greeting). In Chinese etiquette, titles always precede '好'.

example.zh: 王老师好，这是我的作业。
example.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī hǎo, zhè shì wǒ de zuòyè.
example.en: Hello Teacher Wang, this is my homework.
example.es: Hola profesor Wang, esta es mi tarea.
example.fr: Bonjour professeur Wang, voici mes devoirs.

note: In Chinese culture, addressing elders or professionals by their title + 好 expresses high respect.

definition: The most fundamental and ubiquitous greeting in the Chinese language.
composition_note: 你 (nǐ, 'you') + 好 (hǎo, 'good' / 'well'). Literally: 'You be well'.

example.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Hěn gāoxìng rènshí nǐ.
example.fr: Bonjour ! Ravi de faire votre connaissance.

note: Tone Sandhi rule: When two 3rd tones meet (nǐ + hǎo), the first changes into a 2nd tone in pronunciation (ní hǎo).

definition: Standard farewell phrase used when taking leave, literally meaning 'see you again'.
composition_note: 再 (zài, 'again' / 'once more') + 见 (jiàn, 'see' / 'meet'). Exactly like 'au revoir' or 'hasta la vista'.
es: Adiós / Hasta la vista / Hasta luego
note: The most widely used farewell in all registers of Mandarin.

definition: Locative preposition and verb meaning 'to be at/in/on', or grammatical aspect marker indicating an ongoing continuous action (-ing).
composition_note: Composed of 𠂇 (hand action) and 土 (earth/ground), symbolizing staying or being situated upon a place.
en: At / In / On / To be located at / [Progressive aspect marker]
fr: Être à / En / Être en train de

example.en: He is at home studying Chinese.
example.es: Él está en casa aprendiendo chino.
example.fr: Il est à la maison en train d'apprendre le chinois.

note: Crucial distinction: 在 (zài, location/continuous aspect) vs 再 (zài, 'again/repetition'). Both are 4th tone.

definition: Adverb meaning 'again', 'once more', or 'then/further' before doing something else in the future.
composition_note: Pictograph depicting balancing or repeating a weight/measure. Indicates future repetition (unlike 又 yòu for past repetition).
es: Otra vez / De nuevo / Más / Luego

example.fr: Répétez encore une fois, s'il vous plaît.

note: Remember: 再 (zài) is for future repetition ('do it again'), whereas 又 (yòu) is for actions that already occurred again.
